Shop Etsy—your global marketplace for original items made, handpicked, and designed by real people for all budgets. Explore everything from vintage treasures and trending style pieces to personalized jewelry and custom home decor. Get online shopping offers and deals on one-of-a-kind items from small shops, chat with Etsy sellers, track your orders, and more.

Every piece comes from an independent seller. Support your local small shops by shopping one-of-a-kind finds from real people—the kind of pieces you won’t find on a big-box shelf. From clothes shopping for summer, to prepping the perfect patio decor—Etsy has you covered.
 
Download today and shop unique pieces from a special marketplace of sellers.
 
Discover Handmade, One-of-a-Kind Finds
Explore over 15+ marketplace categories of original items from all over the world, including:
• Home Goods & Decor: Find and buy furniture or new prints to style your space, and give the perfect housewarming gifts with pieces like handmade glassware sets or a custom dining table.
• New & Vintage Clothes: Online shop clothing for men, women, and children and elevate your personal wardrobe.*
• Jewelry & Accessories: Accessorize your looks with unique and handmade rings, earrings, and necklaces.
• Original Art, Collectibles & Digital Downloads: Pick up finds from around the world, like Turkish pottery, Portuguese ceramics and custom prints.
• DIY Ideas: Get all the supplies and craft kits you need to throw a themed party or learn a new hobby.

Save More with the Etsy app
Shop top offers and deals from small shops with curated selections of items on sale from sellers you love. Plus, stay updated on sales for your favorite pieces with push notifications!

Make Every Find One-of-a-Kind
Personalize clothes, decor, and style essentials to make your gifts one-of-a-kind. Customization knows no bounds with Etsy.

Enhance your Search
Looking for something specific? Or shopping with a budget? Discover the perfect  pieces with search by image, filtering by shop location, budget and more.

Easily Track Your Order
Track gifts and shipments with real-time updates on your order status—including customized notifications to your taste. Chat with sellers, ask questions and stay in-the-know on your order on the app.

Checkout Safe & Seamlessly
Shop safely with secure payments, including credit/debit, Etsy gift cards, Paypal, Klarna, and quick purchases with Google Pay.

quotes.text:
It’s kinda silly asking them not to use their identity system that was meant precisely for this sort of thing. A user doesn't have to “use” g+ to have a g+ account, and the review process is straightforward when you already have a profile set up on the account you're using to access the Play store with. Perhaps some refinements are in order but as mentioned it doesn't seem to be fully rolled out yet.

And reviews have somewhat more authoritative looking profiles behind them now, for example: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.etsy.android

Also I'm not sure that the boilerplate G+ bashing is necessary.
quotes.story_title: An open letter to Google: Unplug Google Plus from the Play App Store
